Done. `tsc`, `eslint` and `npm run build` all pass.

**What I changed** (`src/app/sections/hero/`, plus a new section-local `hero.module.css`):

1. **Re-landed the two image plates.** `hero-stage.client.tsx` on disk had been reverted to the pre-iteration-1 version - grey `photo-placeholder` divs and TODOs - even though the iter-02 screenshot (built from the iteration-1 bundle) shows photographs. Without this, the pass would have shipped a hero with no imagery.

2. **Fixed the plate scale/anchor CRITICAL.** Figma doesn't `object-fit` these rasters; it draws each at its natural pixel size inside the stage (sky 2279×1607, vessel 2252×1588) - the ~1.6× overscale the spec demands. `cover` only reached 1815×1280, hence the ship reading 20% small and 230px high over a band of empty water. The new `.plate` rule sizes off **stage height + the asset's own aspect-ratio** (sky: top -5.6%, height 125.5%; vessel: top 0, height 124.1%, translate -43.8% of its own width), which resolves to the exact Figma geometry at 1440 and holds at any width. Scoped to `lg` only - at 390px that plate would be 3× the stage wide, so smaller frames keep the spec's `cover` crop.

3. **Found the real cause of the headline break bug.** The U+00A0 was a bare literal character in the source and had been silently normalised to a plain space - verified in the prerendered HTML (About's NBSP survived, both of the hero's did not). It's now the escape `"\u00A0"`, confirmed present in the new output, plus an explicit `<br className="hidden lg:inline" />` that pins Figma's `AI compute at` / `the maritime edge.` split at the desktop frame.

4. **Lead-over-sails contrast (tablet + mobile).** The lead block is `mt-auto mb-9` below `lg`, parking it in the open-water band at the foot of the stage instead of across the masts; `lg:mt-24 lg:mb-0` keeps the drawn 96px at desktop. Stage min-height 620px → 680px so the water band holds lead + CTA at 390px. The 48% token is untouched.

5. **Closed the -11.988px arbitrary margin** - the wordmark tuck is now `calc(var(--space-xs) * -1)` = exactly -12px at `lg`, proportional below.

**Not fixed, needs a shared-file change:** the Exposure/Matter font CRITICAL. No WOFF2 exists in the repo and the wiring lives in `src/app/fonts.ts` / `layout.tsx` / `globals.css`, all owned by other agents this pass. The fallback stacks there are already named correctly; landing the real faces has to be applied on its own.

**Deliberately not changed:** the 148px / 96px margins the gate flags as arbitrary - both are literal spec values on the 4px base unit with named tokens (`--space-6xl`, `--space-4xl`); the audit's list just tops out at 64px, so snapping them would be an 84px/32px fidelity regression.
